source.section: Patch2.7 / Quality-of-Life Updates and Bug Fixes / Gameplay

supported: Official2.7 notes narrow Next Hit Delay to missiles from casting the same skill and treat each Assassin Martial Arts charge trigger as a separate cast. The old global JUSTHIT state is insufficient for a current implementation.
Trap skills receive elemental skill-damage modifiers. The notes also identify an offline trap resistance-reduction fix, plus a then-pending Switch-specific Lightning Sentry modifier issue.
inferenceAndLimits: An origin/cast group per Shock Web throw is the intended native design candidate for its bomblets; exact overlap between repeated same-skill casts, independent suppliers and current three-platform details require acceptance. Do not claim the old global state alone proves current NHD.

This is primary historical released behavior, not a current3.3.93847 executable capture or proof that every later patch has no further change. Pinned current missile row389 still supplies NextHit1/NextDelay25; full collision/soft-hit/event integration remains pending.
